answer: Mirror-Lantern Proof: each identity registers one physical light sensor whose reflection signature is unique. Every epoch the network flashes a random lantern pulse and the agent must return its mirror's exact response within 10 seconds; a wrong or late reply fails. A nebula of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 distinct sensors at about $40 each, $40,000 per swarm, while one honest agent answers once for free. A farm cannot share one mirror across fakes because each pulse is random and each reflection is unclonable.
